name: Yeong Won
description: A refined, clinically assured wholesale skincare house.

clinicalGold.role: Brand accent for rules, icons, and dark surfaces

clinicalGoldInk.role: Accessible gold-toned text on light surfaces

porcelainCream.role: Warm editorial surface and product backdrop

houseInk.role: Primary text, controls, and dark surfaces

display.usage: Headlines, pull quotes, product names, and prominent numerals

body.usage: Body copy, navigation, forms, metadata, and actions

motion.reducedMotion: Render content in its final state and hide ambient video

components.name: Primary Button
components.guidance: Square, at least 44px tall, ink field, white label, gold hover.

components.name: Editorial Link
components.guidance: Compact uppercase action with a two-pixel gold underline.

components.name: Text Field
components.guidance: Transparent field, ink underline, gold focus, inline error.

components.name: Header Navigation Link
components.guidance: 11px uppercase Jost with 0.16em tracking and visible focus.

components.name: Glass Panel
components.guidance: Use only over photography or video, with a solid fallback.

components.name: Concierge Launcher
components.guidance: A deliberate pill exception with a 44px target and focus restoration.

narrative.personality: High-end, elegant, refined, assured, and clinical.
narrative.audience: Wholesale skincare buyers, distributors, and prospective stockists.
principles: Lead with wholesale relevance and make the buyer's next step unmistakable.
Build confidence through precise product, formulation, packaging, and contact information.
Express luxury through controlled hierarchy, strong imagery, and deliberate restraint.
Keep clinical credibility grounded in clear, supportable skincare claims.
avoid: Generic beauty-store and conventional e-commerce styling
Discount language and consumer checkout patterns
Clinical Gold as small text on white
Arbitrary radii, shadows, gradients, and decorative motion
